hero.title: Get Involved
hero.subtitle: Join us in empowering the next generation of Haitian innovators — as a volunteer, partner, donor, or guest speaker.

ways.heading: Ways to get involved
ways.subheading: There are many ways you can support our mission — pick the one that fits you best.

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Mentor a student through a course, teach a workshop in your subject, review project work, or help with the operations behind the programmes. Most volunteers give a few hours a month, remotely. Tell us what you know and when you are free, and we will match you to something real.

partner.title: Partner
partner.description: Schools, universities, businesses, and NGOs work with us to widen what our students can reach — course content, exam preparation, venues, equipment, internships, and scholarship routes. Our current partners are UWC, Coursera, and IICA.

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Programmes are free to every student, and stay that way because donors carry the cost: the learning platform, course materials and certificates, scholarships for the programmes that select participants, and the coordinators who run them in Haiti.

speak.title: Speak
speak.description: Our students rarely meet someone doing the job they are aiming at. A single honest hour about your work, how you got there, and what you would do differently changes what a student believes is available to them. ESLP and our course cohorts both host guest speakers.

support.title: Fuel free education for Haitian students
support.body: Your donation directly supports scholarships, program costs, and resources for students. Every contribution makes a difference.
support.poweredBy: Powered by PayPal. Choose a one-time gift or set up monthly support.
support.taxNotice: EdLight Initiative is a not-for-profit corporation registered in Canada (Corporation No. {number}). We do not yet hold registered-charity status, so we cannot issue tax receipts — we would rather say so before you give than after.

form.heading: Contact us
form.subheading: Tell us how you’d like to get involved and we’ll be in touch soon.
